title: Paginate the orders list
body: The orders list endpoint returns everything in one response and the ops dashboard is getting slow with larger accounts. Add standard limit/offset pagination.

acceptance_criteria.text: list_orders accepts optional limit and offset params, defaulting to limit=20 and offset=0.
The response includes total_count: the number of non-archived orders regardless of the current page. count now reflects the size of the returned page.
Tests cover the default page and an offset page.
